instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my ladder for your shadow until Friday. Don't offer me cash; I taught you to bargain with what the other person wants.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally named a limit instead of apologising. Keep its office hours; I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. You used to hand me every worry before climbing; this time it counts as payment. I'll keep it till you're down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix your kettle for a spoonful of yesterday. Remember, I taught you never to do a repair for nothing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning. You still hover over the kettle instead of getting the cups ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally checked the date. Leave the spoon beside the kettle overnight; by morning you can pay me and we'll start the repair.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll move forward for your photo. Forward means facing the camera. I taught you to use the good light; I'm staying in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Add two; you're finally using the lens instead of making your subject do all the work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now only your face fits. I need a full portrait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Full means all the important parts. You've finally learnt to leave things out; take it before the light changes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll help with your boxes. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift. You remember my first lesson about protecting your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover; you used to think asking for help spoiled a day's work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll still have to hold the door for him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. A wedge will do that. Good, you're thinking ahead; I'll supervise from this chair.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the furniture strike. I taught you floor plans; you're ready for ceilings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always reached for string before asking me. Restraint broke the last treaty; that's when the desks joined in. Apply for an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've found the gap. Recommend her for altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof. You can write the nomination without me this time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our soup bowl said hello. Use the greeting I taught you; crockery hasn't spoken since the Great Washing-Up. Don't just nod at it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wants bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, butter separate. You used to put every gift in one basket; that's how the gravy embargo began.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it wants a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A seat means recognition as a nation. Give it a separate tray; I taught you not to promise the whole table to one guest.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Co-sign for borrowing this barbecue. You used to need me beside you for every inspection; now you can be a joint custodian.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. You finally check before lifting. Write the crack beside both our names and sign; we'll inspect the rest together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll call the shops; you approve a replacement as joint custodian. Use that careful eye you finally developed before we promise her anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've named you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Approve the route; you no longer need me to check every road on your map.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only offered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. All those checks I made you do paid off. Correct it and initial beside my name; we'll both stand behind this route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand beside you. You're our transport lead now; use the calm explanation we practised when you took your first trip. We'll answer their questions together.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave book club, we do the closing response. I taught it to you on your first night; don't make me finish alone again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good projection, wrong words. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we're finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the window down and the driver here for one answer. I'll come beside you. Chapter closed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we ring the farewell bell together. I taught you to answer it; I ought to teach you how to stop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because it rings all day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you finally answered before the second ring today. This is the last one you'll ever have to touch for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You ring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your hand beside mine, like your first morning. One ring together, then put the keys down. I won't call you back for the next customer.
